main.description: Definition of an annotation or judgment experiment.

description.description: Free-text description of this experiment and its purpose.

measureTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the measure type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

measureType.description: What property or behavior is being measured (fallback when measureTypeUri unavailable).

taskTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the response instrument definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

taskType.description: Response instrument: how the response is collected (fallback when taskTypeUri unavailable).

guidelines.description: Instructions or guidelines text shown to participants.

guidelinesFormat.description: Format of the guidelines text, so consumers can render it safely without sniffing. Defaults to plain when omitted.

ontologyRef.description: AT-URI of the ontology record supplying the label or category vocabulary this experiment collects responses over.

personaRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.persona.persona defining the interpretive framework annotators adopt for this experiment.

corpusRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.corpus.corpus whose items this experiment draws stimuli from.

templateRefs.description: References to pub.layers.resource#template records used to generate stimuli for this experiment.

collectionRefs.description: References to pub.layers.resource#collection records providing filler pools for this experiment.

scaleMin.description: Minimum scale value for ordinal-scale judgments.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references (e.g., theoretical framework, methodology citation, task ontology).

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this experiment definition (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this experiment.

reproducibility.description: How this experiment dataset was produced (code, commit, command, environment, seed).

presentation.description: How stimuli are displayed to participants.

recordingMethods.description: Data capture instruments used in this experiment.

design.description: Experiment design parameters: list constraints, distribution strategy, item order.

stimulusExpressionRefs.description: References to pub.layers.expression.expression records used as stimuli in this experiment (text stimuli).

stimulusMediaRefs.description: References to pub.layers.media.media records used as stimuli in this experiment (audio, video, image, signal, and other carrier stimuli).

features.description: Open-ended features carrying experiment detail not covered by the typed fields.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags of the stimuli in this experiment. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

languageRefs.description: Grounded language references for the stimuli, carrying canonical BCP-47 tag, script/region codes, variety label, and a knowledge-graph source (glottolog, iso639-3, cldr). Richer than the languages slug array; use both.

createdAt.description: When this experiment definition record was created.
